editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a childhood memory turns into a real-life nightmare? You get a wild ride with Conan and Ran in this mystery flick. The story kicks off with Ran having scary dreams about her parents' past, while a dangerous criminal escapes prison with a grudge. It feels like a high-stakes game of hide-and-seek where the killer uses playing cards to mark his victims. You will love how it blends a family drama with a ticking-clock thriller, keeping you on edge to see if Conan can solve the puzzle before the killer reaches his final target.

What really works here is the pacing; it never slows down for too long. The twist at the end is satisfying, though some of the older animation might look a bit dated to you. If you like smart detectives and unexpected turns, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: The killer is actually a man who wanted revenge on Ran's father for a past mistake. He tries to trick everyone using a fake identity to get close to the family. Conan figures out the pattern of the playing cards just in time. In the final showdown, Conan uses his gadgets to stop the killer before he can hurt Ran. The mystery of Ran's childhood memory is solved, and her family is finally safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves solving puzzles and classic detective stories.
